Package dev.px.core.setting

Class Settings

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.setting.Settings
public final class Settings extends Object
Factories for every setting type.

SettingHolder inherits these as protected shorthands, so inside a module or HUD element you write bool("Rotations", true) with no qualifier and no registration call. Static-import this class anywhere else.

Numeric factories take their bounds up front because an unbounded slider is always a bug; use .step(...) afterwards to snap the value.
